# Vendored dependency

`json.hpp` is the official nlohmann/json single-header library, pinned to v3.11.3.
It is distributed under the MIT license in `LICENSE.nlohmann-json`.

Downloaded from the upstream release tag:

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/LICENSE.MIT

SHA-256:

- `json.hpp`: `9bea4c8066ef4a1c206b2be5a36302f8926f7fdc6087af5d20b417d0cf103ea6`
- `LICENSE.nlohmann-json`: `86b998c792894ccb911a1cb7994f7a9652894e7a094c0b5e45be2f553f45cf14`

The native and WebAssembly builds use this checked-in copy and require no
network dependency fetch at build time.
